Steveston Village is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 27 homes sold there: 20 houses and 7 townhomes. 20 houses sold in Steveston Village with a median price of $1,762,000 (the middle half sold between $1,356,250 and $1,987,500), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 5% sold above list.
Steveston Village home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

20 houses sold in Steveston Village with a median price of $1,762,000 (the middle half sold between $1,356,250 and $1,987,500), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $822 per square foot, a median year built of 2000 and a median lot of 3,960 square feet. 7 townhomes sold in Steveston Village with a median price of $950,000, taking a median of 43 days to sell at 95.2% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $647 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median strata fee of $613 a month.

items.t: "Steveston Village" is both a Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® sub-area name and a character area in the City's Steveston Area Plan, which also contains the Steveston Village Heritage Conservation Area.
Landmarks: Gulf of Georgia Cannery National Historic Site (12138 Fourth Avenue), Britannia Shipyard Park (5180 Westwater Drive), Imperial Landing Park (4000 Bayview).

The Heritage Conservation Area was designated under section 614 of the Local Government Act. Subdividing, building, adding to or altering buildings or landscape features generally needs a Heritage Alteration Permit unless exempt.

The City's permit guide says Council designated the area in 2009; protected heritage properties need a Heritage Alteration Permit for exterior work, and non-heritage properties need a Development Permit, with a mandatory pre-application meeting.
Along Moncton Street the Area Plan caps buildings at two storeys and 9 m, and it encourages keeping the small historic lots shown on the 1892 lot-line map.

blocks.text: Steveston Village: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: The Area Plan names Steveston Village as the main commercial centre.
Steveston Community Park (4011 Moncton Street) and the Community Centre (4320 Moncton Street, replacement project underway) are on Moncton Street.
Garry Point Park is at 12011 7th Avenue.
Steveston Exchange (Chatham and Moncton area) is served by routes 401, 402, 406, 407 and 413.

blocks.text: Steveston Village: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Bylaw 8204 section 4.4 relaxes the flood construction elevation in the Steveston Village Area where the floor is at or above the fronting sidewalk.
The Area Plan supports the commercial fishing fleet's home port. The Steveston Harbour Authority leases the harbour from Fisheries and Oceans Canada.
The Cannery is a National Historic Site operated by a non-profit society for Parks Canada.
Richmond is about 1 m above sea level; dikes are planned to rise from 3.5 m to 4.7 m.
Liquefaction pockets are possible in a major earthquake.

faq.q: What did homes in Steveston Village sell for?
faq.a: 20 houses sold in Steveston Village between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,762,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Steveston Village?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.6% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Steveston Village sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 20 houses that sold in Steveston Village went for between $1,356,250 and $1,987,500, around a median of $1,762,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Steveston Village sell above asking price?
faq.a: 5% of the 20 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 94.6% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Steveston Village?
faq.a: The median year built was 2000 for the 20 houses sold in Steveston Village.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Steveston Village usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Steveston Village had 4 bedrooms, from the 20 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
